text: Oh, I’m Nina. I just wanted to know what this mystical cave was all about. Who are you?

speaker: Nina
text: (stunned) Wow. Fancy name. More importantly, are you a flipping dragon?

speaker: Taz
text: Are you making fun of me?

speaker: Taz
text: And it’s a good thing you weren’t, or I would have had to breathe fire. My rage knows no bounds. Nothing can quell it once I am angered. Nothing but coffee.

speaker: Nina
text: Are you asking me to make you coffee, Taz?

speaker: Nina
text: Uh...well, no offense, but...can't you make it yourself?

speaker: Nina
text: Which you have yet to confirm up to this point.

speaker: Taz
text: Right. Well, regardless, because of my...abilities...I tend to set all of the coffee on fire.

speaker: Taz
text: I fail to see why that's relevant.

speaker: Taz
text: Anyways...do you think you could help me?
